name_input: GROWMECH INDUSTRIES PRIVATE LIMITED; GROWMECH INDUSTRIES PRIVATE LIMITED
export_evidence: ImportKey India customs page (https://importkey.com/countries/india/growmech-industries-private-limited) shows "Total Shipments 37701 Records detected", "Trading Partners 23", "Latest Cargo 2026-02-27". Exact row quoted: "2026-02-27 | GROWMECH INDUSTRIES PRIVATE LIMITED | TOWER ALLOYS INDUSTRIES LIMITED | INDUSTRIAL MATERIAL-CI BALL TYPE FOOT VALVE FE 150MM | NHAVA SHEVA SEA INNSA1, India | TincanLagos, Nigeria | 84818030 | 1105090". Additional rows same B/L 1105090, same date/destination: HS 84823000 (bearing 23976EMBW33), HS 84821090 (bearing 7205 BEP), HS 84821090 (bearing 6309-2Z/C3). Top destination ports listed: TincanLagos 7214, NHAVA SHEVA SEA 4653, NHAVA SHEVA SEA INNSA1 2411, LAGOS 261, SAHAR AIR CARGO ACC INBOM4 117. Source counter: page claims 37701 shipments; only 4 individual shipment rows were actually visible on the free view (plus 5 buyer/supplier aggregate rows and 5 port aggregates) — the 37701 figure is the site's counter, not a count I verified.
note: Export side is factually confirmed: dated customs/B-L records (B/L 1105090, 2026-02-27, Nhava Sheva -> Tincan Lagos, Nigeria) with HS codes actually shipped being 84818030 / 84823000 / 84821090 (industrial valves and bearings), NOT the declared HS 841370 (centrifugal pumps). Per project rule 3 this is not a rejection ground — the company stays in the base with the HS code corrected to the factual 8481/8482 range and verdict accepted_hs_corrected. Buyer-side aggregates show repeat Nigerian industrial buyers (African Natural Resources and Mines, Abuja Steel Mills, African Foundries, Tower Alloys Industries) — consistent with genuine recurring supply, not a one-off. Domestic (India) supply evidence: NOT established. GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender participation and annual-report domestic/export splits could not be retrieved — zaubacorp and thecompanycheck returned HTTP 403, and web_search was unavailable (searx connection refused) during this run, so no domestic record was seen. Marked unknown rather than none_found because the absence is a tooling limitation, not a negative finding. Revenue and export volume in value terms: null (not public on free views; not invented). Role: appears to be a trader/distributor of industrial MRO goods (valves, bearings) to West Africa rather than a pump manufacturer — role classification left to the registry analyst.
